3.name: Elemental Attunement
3.notes:
At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes, or until you are Incapacitated.

Reach. Your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 10 feet as elemental energy extends from you.

Elemental Strikes. When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you may choose for it to deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. After dealing one of these damage types, you may force the target to make a Strength saving throw. On failure, you can move the target up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

3.name: Manipulate Elements
3.notes: You know the Elementalism spell. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

6.name: Elemental Burst
6.notes:
As a Magic action, expend 2 Focus Points to cause elemental energy to burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes damage equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die. On a success, it takes half damage.

11.name: Stride of the Elements
11.notes: While Elemental Attunement is active, you gain a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

17.name: Elemental Epitome
17.notes:
While Elemental Attunement is active, you gain the following benefits:

Damage Resistance. You gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (your choice). You may change the chosen type at the start of each of your turns.

Destructive Stride. When you use Step of the Wind, your Speed increases by 20 feet until end of turn. During that time, a creature of your choice takes damage equal to one Martial Arts die when you enter a space within 5 feet of it. Damage type is Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (your choice). A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Empowered Strikes. Once per turn, when you hit a target with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal extra damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die. The extra damage matches the strike's type.
